description: Register, update and delete runners on GitLab Server side with the GitLab API.

parameters.name: access_level
parameters.description: Determines if a runner can pick up jobs only from protected branches. If access_level_on_creation is not explicitly set to true, this option is ignored on registration and is only applied on updates. If set to not_protected, runner can pick up jobs from both protected and unprotected branches. If set to ref_protected, runner can pick up jobs only from protected branches. Before community.general 8.0.0 the default was ref_protected. This was changed to no default in community.general 8.0.0. If this option is not specified explicitly, GitLab uses not_protected on creation, and the value set is not changed on any updates. Choices: "not_protected" "ref_protected"

parameters.name: access_level_on_creation
parameters.description: Whether the runner should be registered with an access level or not. If set to true, the value of access_level is used for runner registration. If set to false, GitLab registers the runner with the default access level. The default of this option changed to true in community.general 7.0.0. Before, it was false. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Define if the runners is immediately active after creation. Mutually exclusive with paused. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The unique name of the runner.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: ID or full path of the group in the form group/subgroup. Mutually exclusive with owned and project. Must be group’s numeric ID if registration_token is not set and state=present.

parameters.name: locked
parameters.description: Determines if the runner is locked or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: maximum_timeout
parameters.description: The maximum time that a runner has to complete a specific job. Use 0 to disable the timeout. This is available since community.general 12.1.0. Default: 3600

parameters.name: owned
parameters.description: Searches only runners available to the user when searching for existing, when false admin token required. Mutually exclusive with project since community.general 4.5.0. Mutually exclusive with group. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: paused
parameters.description: Define if the runners is active or paused after creation. Mutually exclusive with active. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: ID or full path of the project in the form of group/name. Mutually exclusive with owned since community.general 4.5.0. Mutually exclusive with group. Must be project’s numeric ID if registration_token is not set and state=present.

parameters.name: registration_token
parameters.description: The registration token is used to register new runners before GitLab 16.0. Required if state=present for GitLab < 16.0. If set, the runner is created using the old runner creation workflow. If not set, the runner is created using the new runner creation workflow, introduced in GitLab 16.0. If not set, requires python-gitlab >= 4.0.0.

parameters.name: run_untagged
parameters.description: Run untagged jobs or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Make sure that the runner with the same name exists with the same configuration or delete the runner with the same name. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tag_list
parameters.description: The tags that apply to the runner. Default: []

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create an instance-level runner
  community.general.gitlab_runner:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    description: Docker Machine t1
    state: present
    active: true
    tag_list: ['docker']
    run_untagged: false
    locked: false
  register: runner # Register module output to run C(gitlab-runner register) command in another task

- name: Create a group-level runner
  community.general.gitlab_runner:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    description: Docker Machine t1
    state: present
    active: true
    tag_list: ['docker']
    run_untagged: false
    locked: false
    group: top-level-group/subgroup
  register: runner # Register module output to run C(gitlab-runner register) command in another task

- name: Create a project-level runner
  community.general.gitlab_runner:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    description: Docker Machine t1
    state: present
    active: true
    tag_list: ['docker']
    run_untagged: false
    locked: false
    project: top-level-group/subgroup/project
  register: runner # Register module output to run C(gitlab-runner register) command in another task

- name: "Register instance-level runner with registration token (deprecated)"
  community.general.gitlab_runner:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    registration_token: 4gfdsg345
    description: Docker Machine t1
    state: present
    active: true
    tag_list: ['docker']
    run_untagged: false
    locked: false
  register: runner # Register module output to run C(gitlab-runner register) command in another task

- name: "Delete runner"
  community.general.gitlab_runner:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    description: Docker Machine t1
    state: absent

- name: Delete an owned runner as a non-admin
  community.general.gitlab_runner:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    description: Docker Machine t1
    owned: true
    state: absent

- name: "Register a project-level runner with registration token (deprecated)"
  community.general.gitlab_runner:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    registration_token: 4gfdsg345
    description: MyProject runner
    state: present
    project: mygroup/mysubgroup/myproject
  register: runner # Register module output to run C(gitlab-runner register) command in another task

return_values.name: error
return_values.description: The error message returned by the GitLab API. Returned: failed Sample: "400: path is already in use"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Success or failure message. Returned: always Sample: "Success"

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: JSON-parsed response from the server. Returned: always
